subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should configured OpenAI-compatible memory embeddings inherit provider private-network policy with exact configured-origin trust when omitted, fail closed when false, and broader private-network access when true?
rationale: The patch has no remaining mechanical defect, but these semantics define an SSRF boundary and an upgrade-sensitive failure mode that require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve complete policy matrix
options.body: Adopt provider request policy as the single source of truth for configured memory embedding network trust.

options.title: Require explicit private opt-in
options.body: Remove omitted exact-origin trust and require allowPrivateNetwork: true, with upgrade guidance for affected private endpoints.

options.title: Keep memory policy separate
options.body: Reject provider inheritance and design a memory-owned trust contract before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve complete policy matrix
recommendation.body: Adopt provider request policy as the single source of truth for configured memory embedding network trust.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre introduced the shared origin-scoped provider SSRF contract that this PR extends into memory embeddings.
